description: One deployment, one shared Markdown checklist. Work together live, turn headings into a task board, focus on one thing, and earn shared XP as you check things off.
detail: Checkerboxer turns one Markdown document into a shared checklist, a board, and a focus workspace. Add tasks, priorities, tags, and due dates without accounts. Changes sync live across browsers, with autosave, conflict detection, downloadable Markdown, and 50 saved revisions. A command palette, playbook templates, day/night themes, and a focus timer keep work moving. Completing tasks earns persistent shared XP, ranks, and levels; quick completions build a session combo with optional sound and reduced-motion-aware effects. Every deployment has its own SQLite data volume. Anyone who can reach the page can read and edit it: do not use it for confidential information without an access-control gateway.
